troubleshooting.title: Why did my collision risk data disappear after a device swap or move?
troubleshooting.shortdesc: Safety ranks may show as N/A immediately after moving a device between assets or databases. See when finishes processing your new data and calculates your collision risk ranking.

condition.p: Collision risk data shows as N/A immediately after moving a device to a new asset or a different database.

cause.p: Moving a device pauses data for a set time. This prevents data from the old asset from mixing with the new one. If you move a device to a different database, resets the data for that day to keep the new data separate.

step.cmd: Wait 7 days for asset swaps. You will see no data for either asset during the week of the move. Data returns once has a full week of new driving data.
Wait 24 hours for database transfers. Data will start recording in the new database the day after the move.
Make sure the asset drives at least 50 km during the first week to help build a new profile.
